lines.2: Unlike the Princess, she was firmly in the ordinary-person category, yet she kept pushing her own convictions through.
lines.3: She was still doing what I'd already given up on.
lines.4: Damn it... That was pretty cool.
lines.7: 「Oh, right... I passed out from Otome's massage...」
lines.8: 「Now Konoe's even showing up in my dreams.」
lines.9: She was seriously going to throw me off my rhythm.
lines.11: Today, each section was getting its final inspection ahead of the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.
lines.12: 「Mm... No problems with the drama club's assignment.」
lines.13: The judges--representatives from the various committees--nodded.
lines.14: 「The gate and the surrounding area are clean too. It must've been hard, but you did well, Konoe.」
lines.15: 「It wasn't me. It was thanks to everyone in the drama club.」
lines.16: 「This will be the drama club's station on the day itself too. I'm counting on you.」
lines.17: 「Yes. Let's all make it a good Sports and Martial Arts Festival.」
lines.18: The judges moved on to the next inspection area.
lines.19: 「All right. I've got to tell everyone in the club this good news right away.」

lines.26: 「And when I say grateful, I don't mean hugely grateful. Just a little grateful!」
lines.27: 「You can thank me after the festival's over.」
lines.28: 「Look at you, you get it. We're doing customer-service practice later.」
